description: You are the Procurement Director at Summit Manufacturing, a mid-size industrial components manufacturer. The purchasing inbox has been unmanaged for the past two weeks while you covered a colleague's leave. There are active RFQ (Request for Quotation) responses from multiple vendors, contract documents requiring legal review, and logistics updates. Before the weekly procurement committee meeting tomorrow, organize the inbox by creating a 'Vendors' folder in Local Folders with two subfolders: 'Active_RFQs' for all open quotation and bid correspondence, and 'Contract_Review' for contract documents requiring review or signature. Move each email to the correct subfolder. Add the account manager from your primary vendor, Sandra Chen at Global Supply Co (s.chen@globalsupplyco.com), to your address book — she handles your highest-volume supply agreements. Set up a message filter so that future emails from the @globalsupplyco.com domain are automatically routed to Active_RFQs. Login: local account, no password needed.
